model_annotation: This visually rotated grouped bar chart illustrates the "Negative log probability" of various language models evaluated across six categories of "Per-specialty terms." The category axis, angled along the lower plane of the rotation, is labeled "Per-specialty terms" and consists of six discrete groups ordered from left to right: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The value axis, running along the left edge of the chart's orientation, is labeled "Negative log probability" and features a linear scale with numeric tick marks that range from -27 at the bottom up to -22 at the top, spaced in intervals of 1 unit. Within each specialty category on the axis, there is a defined cluster of seven adjacent bars originating upward from a shared, unnumbered baseline located below the -27 mark. A legend positioned towards the upper right defines the grouping components: the first bar in each category cluster is shaded light blue and represents the "Mistralv0.2-Base" model. This is immediately followed by a sequence of six bars representing models "Fine-tuned on:" various specialties, applying a progressive color gradient from lightest to darkest. These ordered gradient categories are Cardio (light peach), Gastro (pale orange), Infect (light orange), Neuro (medium orange), Obstetrics (brown-orange), and Pediatrics (dark brown). Across all six groupings, the light blue base model bar is consistently the shortest, terminating at approximate axis values between -27 and -26.5. The six succeeding fine-tuned model bars systematically reach higher points on the value axis within each group, displaying top edges that approximate values between -26.5 and -25.5. The bars within the fine-tuned subsets exhibit relatively uniform lengths compared to one another, and no isolated bars are bolded, distinctively outlined, or otherwise visually emphasized beyond the standard color scheme.
